title: Official External Acquisition Runner
goals: Define a dedicated external acquisition action contract separate from resource search.
Add a fixture-first official runner sidecar before production downloader adapters.
Wire host-owned idempotency, cancellation, progress, and audit semantics.
Preserve redaction and host-owned acquisition policy boundaries.
non_goals: Browser raw URL or password resubmission
Completing the separate web acquisition intake lane
Multiple production runner adapters before the fixture contract is stable
